plan_vs_policy.note: Following the plan against letting the same simulated drafter choose freshly at every pick. A negative number is the cost of committing to a plan, plus a known bias: the rest-of-draft policy inside a rollout is the same heuristic, so a forced pick leaves it repairing a roster it did not plan. See methodology.md §2.

rollout_settings.control: matched no-forced-pick arm on the same samples

settings.availability_model: your seat drafts off ADP so availability measures the room, not your plan
